title: Every capacity upward
notes: The same packages and d = 3, the naive way: try 8, 9, 10 and so on until one fits. 8 to 13 each need a fourth day; 14 is the first capacity that fits. 7 checks and 49 reads, against 5 checks and 40 reads for binary search. Close, because 14 sits near the bottom of the range.
